obfuscation_indicators: considerable amount of time, resources and continued support
risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative disclosure, but highlights meaningful risks from declining revenue, reliance on distributors and concentrated product lines, international execution, currency movements, and product-development delays. Credit risk is elevated by amended EBITDA covenants, mandatory accelerated principal payments, excess-cash sweeps, and minimum liquidity requirements, despite stated covenant compliance at June 30, 2015.
